_doc: The Black Knight easter egg (src/black_knight.py). About one run in four he guards a little stone bridge on one floor from 15 to 19. His fighting numbers are in data/monsters.json (black_knight); his sword is flesh_wound in data/items/weapon.json. Every line he says is here.
greet_chronicle: Met a knight on a little stone bridge. He said none shall pass. There was a perfectly good way round.

stage_lines.4: All right, we'll call it a draw.

stage_messages.1: Your blow takes off the Black Knight's left arm, shield and all.
stage_messages.2: Off comes the Black Knight's sword arm. He looks at it, then at you.
stage_messages.3: You take the Black Knight's leg off at the hip. He is still hopping mad.
stage_messages.4: The Black Knight's last leg goes. He lands on the bridge, a torso in a helmet.

teeter: The Black Knight teeters on his one leg, still swinging his shoulders at you.
teeter_lines: I've still got one good leg, which is all I need!
sword_drop: The Black Knight's sword clatters onto the bridge beside him.
draw_chronicle: Fought the Black Knight to what he insists was a draw. He has opinions.
draw_by_pet_chronicle: {pet} took the Black Knight apart one limb at a time while I watched. He insists it was a draw.
sword_chronicle: I have the Black Knight's sword. He has opinions about that.

0: Is that a sword or a butter knife?
You'll have to do better than that.
I've had worse from my barber.
1: I've got another one, you know.
Is that the best you can do?
2: Just you wait till I get my boot in.
Stand still and let me kick you!
3: Stand still so I can barge you!

walk_away_lines: Leaving already? We were just getting started!
That's right, run! None shall pass!
torso_pass_lines: Oi! I said none shall pass!
That doesn't count. I wasn't ready.
Mind where you put your feet!
You've got a nerve, stepping over a knight!
torso_leave_lines: Come back here, I'll bite your legs off!
Coward! Come back and finish what you started!
I've still got my teeth, you know!
Fine! Run away! I'll be right here!
torso_bite: The Black Knight bites at your ankle. Your boot does not notice.
stand_firm: The Black Knight will not budge from his bridge.
